lots.title: Building Services Specification - Planned Maintenance and Remedial Works (Lot 8)
lots.description: London Borough of Bexley contract for delivery of Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM), Reactive/Remedial Maintenance, and Specialist Building Services across the Council's operational estate, contract commencing SEPT 2026. Supplier is responsible for safe, compliant, and efficient operation of all mechanical, electrical, building fabric, and specialist facilities management assets, with full integration into the Council's CAFM system (Civica/TF Cloud).
requirements: Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) scheduled in accordance with statutory requirements, SFG20, CIBSE Guide M, and manufacturer recommendations.
Statutory compliance inspections and certification within legally required timeframes.
Minor building fabric repairs to maintain integrity and safety of building structures.
Specialist services support for BMS, fire detection/suppression, generators, UPS, lightning protection, and structural surveys.
Mobilisation and asset collection: comprehensive asset verification, tagging, and CAFM onboarding.
Environmental and social value delivery aligned with Council objectives.
24/7 helpdesk and emergency response capability for all critical systems (BMS alarms, life safety systems, essential plant).
Adherence to agreed SLAs for response and resolution times, prioritising critical failures.
Reactive works carried out by certified, competent engineers with manufacturer accreditations where applicable.
Root cause analysis and corrective actions for all failures.
All completed tasks, service reports, and certificates uploaded to CAFM (Civica/TF Cloud) within 48 hours of completion.
Preparation and submission of site-specific Risk Assessment and Method Statements (RAMS) for all works.
Dynamic risk assessments to address changing site conditions.
Asbestos register checks prior to any work and immediate stop-work if ACMs encountered.
Strict adherence to permit-to-work systems for hot works, electrical isolations, confined spaces, and roof access.
Operation of an ISO 14001-compliant Environmental Management System.
Segregation of waste streams and legal disposal via approved licensed carriers.
Implementation of carbon reduction and energy efficiency measures; recommendations for low-carbon asset replacements.
Delivery of measurable social value outcomes: local employment, apprenticeships, SME engagement, sustainability initiatives.

Mobilisation plan submission within 10 working days of award; mobilisation period 6-12 weeks covering asset collection/tagging, condition/lifecycle/criticality assessment, Year 1 PPM schedules, competency matrix and staffing plan, and CAFM system integration.
Identification and maintenance of agreed critical spares stock, available on-site or within 12-24 hour delivery, reviewed annually or after major plant changes.
100% asset audit within the first three (3) months of contract commencement capturing asset type/model/serial, age/condition, compliance status, lifecycle analysis, and criticality rating.

Production of monthly operational reports (PPM completion, statutory compliance tracker, risk register, social value tracker, energy-saving opportunities, performance dashboard, exception reporting, continuous improvement, financial summary, forward look) submitted electronically and presented at monthly contract review meetings.

evaluation_criteria.summary: 100% statutory compliance across all assets and inspections.
95% of planned preventive maintenance tasks completed on time each month.
Reactive response SLA compliance between 90% and 95%.
At least 80% of reactive faults resolved on first visit.
All task records, reports, and certificates uploaded to Council CAFM within 48 hours of completion.
Quarterly social value delivery against agreed commitments (local employment, apprenticeships, SME engagement, sustainability).
